module purpose: Implements a small custom-function unit (CFU) that holds a 4-word key in key_mem written via CSRs, latches operands on a start request, runs an XTEA-like core (registers xtea.opa/opb/sum/res/done and combinational tmp_* that index key_mem), and produces a 32-bit result and a valid flag on result_o/valid_o.

use-case flows.value: write a 32-bit key word into key_mem via a CSR write
start request latches operands into xtea.opa/xtea.opb and sets the core start bit (xtea.done(0))
core sequencing and arithmetic: update xtea.sum, select key_mem via xtea.sum, compute tmp_r and xtea.res from operands and selected key words
export the computed result and a valid indication on result_o and valid_o, under rtype_i/funct3_i selection
read back a key_mem word through the CSR read data port csr_rdata_o (indexed by csr_addr_i)
reset clears key_mem and the xtea registers (done/opa/opb/sum/res)

conceptual assets.concept: Stored CFU key words (the 4×32-bit words held in key_mem)
conceptual assets.reasoning: The module explicitly stores key words in key_mem by CSR writes and uses those words in the cipher computation. RTL: csr_write_access writes csr_wdata_i into key_mem (assignment at line 179). The map records the write data path: PORT csr_wdata_i has a CARRIES record at occurrence 2 (line 179) targeting key_mem, and SIGNAL key_mem has a CLOCKED_BY record at occurrence 3 (line 179) targeting clk_i and a RESET_BY at occurrence 2 (line 176) targeting rstn_i. The key words are read back to CSR output (csr_rdata_o <= key_mem(...) at line 185; map: csr_rdata_o DERIVES_FROM key_mem at occurrence 2, line 185) and are also read combinationally into tmp_z (tmp_z selection uses key_mem at lines 236–237; map: key_mem SOURCES at occurrences 5,6 lines 236,237 target tmp_z). Altering key_mem therefore changes tmp_r (line 238), xtea.res (lines 221–224) and the exported result (line 249), establishing integrity of key_mem for correct CFU operation.

conceptual assets.concept: Operation operands — the input words latched into xtea.opa and xtea.opb used by the core
conceptual assets.reasoning: The RTL explicitly latches operands from the CPU on a start and uses them in the arithmetic that produces the CFU result. RTL: in xtea_core, when (start_i='1') and (rtype_i = r3type_c) the code assigns xtea.opa <= rs1_i and xtea.opb <= rs2_i (lines 204–207). Map evidence: PORT start_i has a GATES record at occurrence 2 (line 204) targeting xtea.opa and xtea.opb; PORT rs1_i and rs2_i each have a CARRIES record (occurrence 2, lines 205/206) targeting xtea.opa/xtea.opb; SIGNAL xtea.opa and xtea.opb have CLOCKED_BY records at occurrences 3 (lines 205/206) targeting clk_i and COPIES from rs1_i/rs2_i at the same occurrences. Those registers drive the combinational tmp_* logic (lines 232–238) and thus xtea.res (lines 221–224) so their integrity is required for correct results.

conceptual assets.concept: Round accumulator and key-selector (xtea.sum) that controls which key word is used and round sequencing
conceptual assets.reasoning: xtea.sum is explicitly updated by the core and is used to index key_mem for the arithmetic that contributes to the result. RTL: within the gated branch (if xtea.done(0)='1') the code assigns xtea.sum either from xtea.opa or by adding/subtracting xtea_delta_c (lines 213–218). The sum value is used in combinational selection of tmp_z from key_mem via slices of xtea.sum (lines 236–237), and tmp_z then feeds tmp_r (line 238) and ultimately xtea.res (lines 221–224). Map evidence: SIGNAL xtea.sum has CLOCKED_BY records at occurrence 3 (line 214) targeting clk_i and SELECTS records at occurrences 8 and 9 (lines 236–237) that target tmp_z; PORT funct3_i has a GATES record at occurrence 2 (line 213) targeting xtea.sum. Corrupting xtea.sum changes which key word is selected and thus breaks the computed result, establishing integrity of xtea.sum.

conceptual assets.concept: Computed CFU result (xtea.res) that the block exports on result_o
conceptual assets.reasoning: The design computes a result register and exports it; the correctness of that register is required by consumers. RTL: xtea.res is written from tmp_b/tmp_r under the xtea.done(0) branch (lines 221–224) and result_select assigns result_o <= xtea.res for the cipher-case (line 249). Map evidence: SIGNAL xtea.res has CLOCKED_BY records at occurrence 3 (line 222) targeting clk_i and has a CARRIES record at occurrence 5 (line 249) targeting result_o, while PORT result_o has a COPIES record at occurrence 2 (line 249) targeting xtea.res. The module therefore realizes the computed result in xtea.res (stored) and exits it via result_o; integrity of xtea.res is established because it directly becomes the externally visible result.

conceptual assets.concept: Operation completion state (xtea.done) that gates when a result is valid and exported
conceptual assets.reasoning: The module records completion bits that the consumer treats as 'valid'. RTL: xtea.done bits are cleared and shifted in the core (lines 200–201) and are set by the start sequence (line 207). result_select uses xtea.done(1) to drive valid_o for cipher results (line 250). Map evidence: SIGNAL xtea.done has CLOCKED_BY records at occurrences including occurrence 4 (line 201) targeting clk_i and a GATES record from start_i at occurrence 6/7 (line 207) targeting xtea.done; PORT valid_o has a DERIVES_FROM record at occurrence 2 (line 250) targeting xtea.done and SIGNAL xtea.done is SOURCES for valid_o at occurrence 5 (line 201). If xtea.done is incorrect the module reports an incorrect valid flag or masks the result, establishing the integrity requirement for xtea.done. The input start_i also gates and thus serves as a setting point for this state (line 204 map record).
